details: Shelah--Hodges threshold/Littlestone comparison: $\mathrm L(\mathcal H)\geq\lfloor\log_2\mathrm T(\mathcal H)\rfloor$. Together with the existing reverse logarithmic relation, the two quantities are logarithmically comparable in both directions.
proof: The Shelah--Hodges comparison, quoted in the cited source, states $\lfloor\log_2\mathrm T(\mathcal H)\rfloor\leq\mathrm L(\mathcal H)\leq2^{\mathrm T(\mathcal H)}$. Its left inequality is exactly this logarithmic lower bound.
name: Littlestone Dimension / Threshold Dimension (logarithmic)
